summary_zh: 泰國政府加速處理普拉恰武里石油外洩，將嚴格管控高風險工廠，環保稽查壓力持續上升（P034）。另有大型民企示警AI投資增加但招聘有限，人才技能升級成新痛點；BOI則推動資料中心與AI供應鏈承接全球投資。製造商需同步強化排放管控與人才轉型。
summary_en: Thailand is tightening control of high-risk factories after the Prachinburi oil spill, so environmental enforcement pressure keeps rising. Big firms warn AI investment outpaces hiring and urge faster reskilling. BOI pushes data centers and the AI supply chain to capture global investment.
